worldcombat.skill.icehammer.summary: A fist packed in thick ice drops straight down: the blow knocks the target back and the ice shell bursts on it (leaving the chilled identity, slightly slower), while the impact freezes a patch of ground for a while. The user staggers with Speed down 1 stage. Already-chilled targets take more. The glaciate form freezes longer with a larger patch at the cost of a lighter hit and a slower cast.
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.use.0: Trade a heavy ice blow for one hard target and slow it down
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.use.1: Freeze the ground at the impact point to force movement
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.use.2: Answer an already-chilled target with a heavier shatter
One ice-packed blow deals %1$s physical damage; reach %2$s blocks.
A hit knocks the target %1$s blocks and lowers the user's Speed %2$s stage(s).
A hit leaves the target chilled for %1$s s (slightly slower) and bursts %2$s ice shards.
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.glaciate.on: Glaciate form: chill duration x1.4, frost radius %1$s blocks and frost lasting %2$s s, freezing the target hard; costs power x0.92 and a slower wind-up and recovery.
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.glaciate.off: Shatter form: a heavier, faster hit, but a shorter chill and a smaller frozen patch.
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.growth.0: From level %1$s the blow power rises to %2$s and the shard count to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.growth.1: From level %1$s the blow power rises to %2$s and the frost radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.preference.g: On: chill duration x1.4 and a larger, longer-lasting frozen patch, freezing the target hard; costs power x0.92, wind-up +2 ticks, recovery +2 ticks, cooldown +6 ticks. Off (shatter): a heavier, faster hit, but a shorter chill and a smaller patch.
worldcombat.skill.icehammer.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger opens the blow from farther, but it is easier to sidestep during the wind-up.
On: targets already carrying the chilled identity rank higher, since the ice shell is more brittle and this blow is heavier; off: all targets score the same.
